blockers.detail: Did not diff the launchd daemon's ~110 uncommitted hcli/ files. This audit is HEAD 04193ccbc.
No U50/FPGA on this host. All FPGA findings are SOURCE_INSPECTION of sim/prehardware code. Hardware present: Apple M3 Ultra CPU/GPU/UMA and a real ANE (ANE not exercised in this lane).
